title: The Endless Winter
author: Zephyrine Montrose
blurb: Ulyana Brightwater, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
